roadmap.title: First matches and house rules
roadmap.description: Play your first matches in local Classic UNO against 3 AI with 3 house rules on. Press the UNO button each time you hold 2 cards.

roadmap.title: Counters during normal play
roadmap.description: Keep playing and use Wild and +4 cards freely. Turn No Bluffing on while you build Joker, then off for Nerves of Steel. Watch for missed UNO calls.

roadmap.title: Online wins and the 700-point game
roadmap.description: Win 10 full online matches, then win one long game with a high score limit.

achievements.summary: Finish your first round of UNO, win or lose.

steps.text: Start any match and play one round to the end.
Win a full game of UNO.

guide.context: The call button shows at the right of your cards once you hold 2 cards and can play one.

steps.text: With 2 cards in hand and a playable one, tap the UNO button as you lay down a card.
Repeat 10 times. Winning is not needed.

achievements.description: Successfully make opponent draw cards with Wild Draw Four 10 times.
achievements.summary: Force opponents to draw by playing Wild Draw Four 10 times.

guide.context: A challenge can cancel your +4 and make you draw, so it only counts when the opponent takes the cards.

steps.text: In the match setup, turn on the @mechanic{No Bluffing} rule so opponents cannot challenge your +4.
Play Wild Draw Four whenever you can and let the opponent draw. Repeat 10 times.

achievements.description: Successfully Challenge a missed UNO 15 times.
achievements.summary: Challenge a missed UNO successfully 15 times.

guide.context: AI opponents call UNO very fast, so real players are easier to catch.

steps.text: Watch for an opponent who plays down to 1 card without calling UNO.
Press the exclamation-mark button that replaces the UNO button before they call. They draw 2. Repeat 15 times.

achievements.description: Win 5 matches with at least 3 house rules.
achievements.summary: Win 5 matches while at least 3 house rules are switched on.

guide.context: A match ends when your set rounds or point limit is finished, not after one round.

steps.text: In the match setup, turn on any 3 house rules.
Play each match to the end and win it. Repeat until you have 5 wins.

guide.context: Wild Draw Four, Wild, Draw Two, Skip, and Reverse all count.

steps.text: Play action cards in normal matches until you reach 100 plays in total.

guide.context: A game ends when your set rounds or point limit is finished. You can pause and come back with the Resume match card.

steps.text: From the main menu, choose local play (far left), then @mechanic{Classic UNO} with 3 AI.
Win 5 full games.

achievements.description: Change the Color with Action Cards 40 times.
achievements.summary: Change the color 40 times with Wild or Wild Draw Four cards.

guide.context: Pick a color different from the one on the pile.

steps.text: Play a Wild or Wild Draw Four and choose a new color. Repeat 40 times.

guide.context: You win when the opponent who played the +4 held a card of the current color. With Force Play on, the AI draws and then plays a +4 at once. You will most likely lose that challenge, so skip it.

steps.text: In the match setup, turn @mechanic{No Bluffing} off.
Turn @mechanic{Jump In} off so no one jumps in with another +4.
When an opponent plays a +4 on you, challenge it if they could have played a card of the current color.
With Stacking on, always challenge a stacked +4. Repeat until you have 20 wins.

guide.context: A lobby with only you and 3 AI still counts as online. Single-round lobbies finish faster than multi-round ones.

steps.text: Create or join an online lobby.
Win 10 full games, not single rounds.

achievements.description: Win a game with more than 700 points.
achievements.summary: Win a game while your score is above 700 points.

guide.context: Points can add up over several rounds.

steps.text: Create a lobby and set the score limit to 750 or 1000.
Keep playing rounds and win the game with more than 700 points.
